svg.title: Partition, segments, records and offsets
svg.desc: Partition payments-0 holds two segments. Segment 0 is closed and holds records at offsets 0 to 3 at byte positions 0, 45, 92 and 144, with matching index entries. Segment 4 is active and holds offsets 4 to 6 at positions 0, 46 and 94, with offset 7 next.
